improvements_suggested: Emit phase-level elapsed-time spans and restartable checkpoints for every experiment, with time-budget warnings on long synthesis phases.

Record concurrent model count, selected runner, and selection reason at launch; route to DualGPURunner only when at least two models are loaded in parallel.
Add lease-aware cleanup for inactive GPU processes after their owning task ends, with an explicit keep-alive override.

Join task-window GPU telemetry and process ownership to compute-bound experiment receipts.

meta_reflection: The reconstructed timing identifies where elapsed time accumulated, but the supplied data does not explain why those paths were slow. Without phase spans, task-aligned GPU telemetry, launch receipts, or a measured counterfactual, a nonzero time-savings estimate would not be defensible.
